lgn.text: Slivers are reintroduced as clones of the originals through the Riptide Project, and the first sliver slips out of Riptide in the form of a junior researcher.
After breaking free of the project the slivers quickly adapt to life on Otaria, and the Riptide Project loses control of its last slivers so that the island is completely overrun.
Within weeks, more slivers nest in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.
